messages:
Zoe M.: hey all, Zoe here  first day. I ran `kubectl config get-contexts` and only see `microk8s`. I need read on `staging` and a personal namespace `zoe-onboard` for tutorials. Who should I ping and what exact info do you need? :wave:

Ravi (DevEx): welcome Zoe! :tada: open an eng-infra ticket and include: corp email, manager, namespaces and perms (read/write), and paste `kubectl config view --minify --flatten`. We have a helper script for corp machines if you prefer: `curl -s https://go.redwood/get-kubecreds.sh | bash` (corp laptop only).

Zoe M.: pasted flattened kubeconfig (it's tiny):
```
apiVersion: v1
clusters: []
contexts: []
current-context: microk8s
kind: Config
preferences: {}
users:
- name: microk8s
```

I opened INF-1234 and linked @kevin_m.

onboard-bot: ticket INF-1234 created and assigned to eng-infra. https://tickets.redwood/INF-1234

Marta (Eng-Infra): hi Zoe  process note: we map SSO groups to k8s RBAC. For onboarding we usually create `zoe-onboard` ns and bind `edit`. For staging we'll add you to `redwood-staging-read` unless you explicitly need create/exec rights. If you need temporary staging write, include an expiry (we default to 48h).

Marta (Eng-Infra): done  created namespace and applied bindings. Please run these to verify:
```
kubectl config get-contexts
kubectl auth can-i list pods --namespace=zoe-onboard
kubectl auth can-i create deployments --namespace=staging
kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=zoe-onboard
```

Zoe M.: ran them  `get-contexts` now shows `redwood-staging` and `zoe-onboard`; `auth can-i` yes for list in `zoe-onboard` and no for create in staging (fine). I can `kubectl run` a tiny pod in my ns. thanks! :raised_hands:

Ravi (DevEx): two quick tips: 1) switch context explicitly: `kubectl config use-context redwood-staging`, 2) if kubeconfig ends up with duplicate entries merge and flatten: `kubectl config view --flatten > ~/.kube/config && chmod 600 ~/.kube/config`. Ping infra if anything looks off.
